allow: Shell(python3 - <<'EOF' import re, os text = open('docs/system-design/high-level/concepts/fault-tolerance.md').read() headers = re.findall(r'^### (.+)$', text, re.M) def anchor(h): a = h.lower() a = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 \-]', '', a) return a.replace(' ', '-') valid = {anchor(h) for h in headers} links = re.findall(r'\]\(#([^)]+)\)', text) missing = [l for l in links if l not in valid] print("anchors referenced:", len(links), "| missing:", missing if missing else "none") rel = re.findall(r'\]\(([a-z0-9\-]+\.md)[^)]*\)', text) base = 'docs/system-design/high-level/concepts' bad = [r for r in rel if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(base, r))] print("relative links:", sorted(set(rel)), "| broken:", bad if bad else "none") print("### sections:", len(headers)) EOF)
